decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own product page, it reflects a meaningful recent commitment and management can still treat any slow uptake as normal market build-up.
The homepage placement and publicly highlighted Germany premiere make this a very visible commitment, which strongly lowers the chance that management withdraws it so soon.
Its dedicated page shows clear investment and portfolio intent, and in German B2B equipment trading a new module would usually be given more time before abandonment.
This was announced prominently on the homepage as a new B2 multifinishing solution, so the public and strategic commitment argues strongly for continuation.
Although less publicly emphasized than the homepage products, the firm has still launched and listed it explicitly, making management likely to persist rather than admit a premature withdrawal.
Even with lighter website prominence, the cited customer installation provides an early reference case that lets management justify staying the course.
